reviewScope: Independent source-only design challenge before implementation; no production edits or runtime operations
proposal: Explicit foreground PURCHASE replacement of expired stored Google paid authority by a newly verified independent unlinked same-account funded root

oldProviderExpiryDecision.recommendation: Stored-source expiration can authorize replacement of LOCAL authority when all new independent funding/ownership/CAS constraints hold. Old raw provider token/expiry proof is not needed for that bounded claim.
oldProviderExpiryDecision.mandatoryLimit: It does not prove old Play subscription is actually expired, canceled, nonrenewing or globally nonoverlapping with every provider period; source may be stale. Do not revoke/delete old ownership or modify old usage.
oldProviderExpiryDecision.ifStrongerProductPolicyRequired: If product policy forbids replacing authority unless every old provider subscription is presently inactive, actual trusted old-provider evidence is required; stored expiry cannot meet that stronger requirement.
oldProviderExpiryDecision.noExtraDecisionForAllowance: Existing200 per independently funded period/no carryover policy can remain unchanged; no blanket200 regrant when a matching global usage row already exists.

requiredMigrationEligibility: Only explicit foreground PURCHASE; no RESTORE, general synchronize or background capability.

Fresh canonical package/product/base-plan, normal funded P1M proof, exact current account obfuscated binding, single unlinked root, strict expiry/funding equality and existing test-only policy retained.
Previous source validated same-account Google/product with valid head and immutable period; stored access end <= now and <= new funded start, previous funded end <= new start.
New root owner AND locator absent in the same inventoried ownership observation; all new ownership claims remain conditional absent.
Old head owner AND locator exact validated same account/product; readonly exact conditions in the SAME funding transaction.
Source revision EXACT previous+1; new root identity differs; malformed/missing legacy evidence stops rather than bypass.

Typed memory-only capability binds account, old paid source/head, new root, funded dates and exact observed ACCESS. Writer independently revalidates required constraints; a marker type or client/body bool alone is not authorization.
Exact previous ACCESS condition attached to ACCESS Put; old immutable period condition retained once.
All auth/profile/age/deletion/device/key inventory/ownership inventory and request receipt conditions remain transactional.
Old period/global usage and ownership never reset/deleted; new period uses current global funding_actions preserving preexisting used/reserved or failing reconciliation.
No migration backwards to an already owned different root; same-current-root callbacks and exact historical receipt replay remain normal.
transactionCompositionWarnings: DynamoDB forbids multiple actions on the same item. New claim actions already contain inventory guard; old-head evidence adds only readonly owner+locator conditions, not prepare_claim_actions(old).
Existing writer adds previous period condition on a new period; do not append duplicate old-period condition.
Exact ACCESS CAS belongs on the existing ACCESS Put, never a second ACCESS ConditionCheck.
A simultaneous historical settlement may conflict with old-period exact condition; fail atomically and require fresh observations, no partial ownership grant or blind retry.

outOfAppScope.recommendation: Keep outOfAppPurchaseContext explicitly unsupported in this minimal change.
outOfAppScope.reason: Its expiredPurchaseToken pointer is not linkedPurchaseToken and does not satisfy fresh current account binding by itself. Treating it as lineage would broaden provider association/restore policy.
outOfAppScope.futurePrerequisite: Separate verified predecessor/provider context mapping, exact retained head ownership/locator and account association policy; fresh old-provider inactivity evidence only if claiming actual provider expiration.

fixedPredicateInstrumentation.recommendation: Attach only finite internal original-site reason to the existing fixed-code exception; read that reason at exact Dev verify logger under existing gates, retaining public status/code/retryable semantics.
suggestedSites: handoff previous head disconnected and scoped migration precondition failure
writer unscoped root change or backwards source revision
fixedPredicateInstrumentation.privacy: No token/hash/account/order/request ID, dates or raw provider fields/claims/exception text; no extra provider read or rejected-request re-evaluation.
fixedPredicateInstrumentation.collectorCompatibility: Use a versioned/new fixed event or explicitly coordinate strict collector schema; do not silently add arbitrary keys to an existing exact-schema event.
